foundation.representation: Ground-contact concrete slab, not the catalog DC basement; no Kiva/soil dynamics or slab-edge code claim

geometry.additional_one_story_sizes: 1M and 1L: length=sqrt(workbook area * 5/3), width=sqrt(workbook area / (5/3)); same 8 ft height. Provisional geometry, not finalized workbook footprints.

limitations: Not a validated Marvin residential baseline.
No explicit basement, ventilated attic, room partitions, ductwork, product glazing, humidity control, or mechanical ventilation.
Constant provisional ground temperature is not a calibrated foundation model.
Sizing disabled: unlimited ideal loads; no equipment sizing conclusions.

operation.occupancy_periods: 00:00–07:00 and 18:00–24:00 night fraction; 07:00–18:00 day fraction; same every day; lights/equipment follow occupancy

roof.insulation: Material:NoMass; selected nominal insulation R only; gypsum and deck separate; no surface films
roof.representation: Flat compact roof/ceiling; no separately ventilated attic zone or roof framing bridges

source: Software V0 assumptions, not workbook decisions

windows.geometry: One centered equivalent window per facade; identical opposing pairs, no frames, dividers, overhangs or product designation

engine_defaults: Unspecified opaque material absorptance uses EnergyPlus defaults: thermal 0.9, solar/visible 0.7. Vinyl explicitly uses solar/visible 0.6. No external shading, frames or dividers; no scheduled thermostat setback.
